crossRefs.note: “Now therefore, my sons, listen to me, for blessed are those who keep my ways.
For by me your days will be multiplied. The years of your life will be increased.
What man is he who fears Yahweh? He shall instruct him in the way that he shall choose.
His soul will dwell at ease. His offspring will inherit the land.
Oh that my people would listen to me, that Israel would walk in my ways!
Oh that you had listened to my commandments! Then your peace would have been like a river and your righteousness like…
Turn your ear, and come to me. Hear, and your soul will live. I will make an everlasting covenant with you, even the…
While he was still speaking, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them. Behold, a voice came out of the cloud, saying…
My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me.
who by the power of God are guarded through faith for a salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.
My son, let them not depart from your eyes. Keep sound wisdom and discretion:
In the fear of Yahweh is a secure fortress, and he will be a refuge for his children.
He will not be afraid of evil news. His heart is steadfast, trusting in Yahweh.
You will keep whoever’s mind is steadfast in perfect peace, because he trusts in you.
When you hear of wars and disturbances, don’t be terrified, for these things must happen first, but the end won’t come…
“By your endurance you will win your lives.
Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? Could oppression, or anguish, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness…

translations.web: But whoever listens to me will dwell securely, and will be at ease, without fear of harm.”
translations.bsb: But whoever listens to me will dwell in safety, secure from the fear of evil.”
translations.kjv: But whoso hearkeneth unto me shall dwell safely, and shall be quiet from fear of evil.
translations.asv: But whoso hearkeneth unto me shall dwell securely, And shall be quiet without fear of evil.
